entries.text: Choose a writing language by name, regional variant, or code, and add custom or regional translation targets.
Set default Article and translation languages in a dedicated Language defaults section, with controls to search, add, and remove targets.
Find provider connections and model setup separately from Assistant behavior preferences in Settings.
Settings now appears before the style profile in the Library utilities.
Find guidance in the user guide for requesting access to, correction of, or deletion of personal data.
The Assistant composer uses less padding, leaving more room for its contents.
